banner: Rendered by `omx-contract render --target c --package plugin-db` from data/constants.json, the numbers
plugin-db declares. It includes nothing, so a consumer that needs a number and no digest builds without OpenSSL;
the values are changed where they are declared and the file is rendered again, never edited here.
c.brief: The numbers plugin-db declares: the length of a digest written in hex.

PLUGIN_DB_PIN_SHA256_HEX_LEN.doc: The characters of a SHA-256 digest written in hex, two a byte: the length of every file digest a pin records and of the buffer a reader writes one into. Declared here so that a consumer that needs the length and no digest (plugin-hostd's command parser) reads it without OpenSSL; pin.h names it PHD_SHA256_HEX_LEN.
